evidence: Official site confirmed at hull.ac.uk. ACCOMMODATION: hull.ac.uk/life-at-hull/accommodation confirms all three catalog entries — Westfield Court (from £135/wk), Taylor Court (from £99/wk), The Courtyard (en-suite) — accurate. SCHOLARSHIPS: official scholarships-and-awards/international-undergraduate-fee-waivers page lists ONLY an 'International Undergraduate Fee Waiver' of £2,000/year; NO 'Wilberforce Scholarship' and no '£3,000 International Scholarship' found — catalog scholarships are wrong/fabricated. PRICES: official UG/PGT fees-and-funding pages redirect international users to a separate international guide and do not expose figures via fetch; catalog tuition (GBP 14,500–19,500) is unverifiable and likely stale. CAMPUSES: Main Campus in Hull is accurate; 'Hull Campus' is a duplicate filler; 'Hull London Campus' derives from edvoy partner listing, not an official Hull campus. PROGRAMS: core degrees (BSc CS, BA Business, LLB Law, BEng, BSc Psychology/Nursing/Biochemistry, MBA, MSc Data Science) are plausible, but ~50 entries are edvoy-aggregator-sourced and unverified against official source, plus 12 MA programs are mislabeled as bachelor level. Founding year 1927, City of Culture 2017, Philip Larkin facts are correct. 6 official-domain fetches + 1 web search used.
